name: European long distance path E7 - part Hungary
description_md:
The European long distance path E7 in Hungary is a waymarked hiking route spanning 762.1 km. This trail is part of an international waymarked hiking network and is signposted as E7.

The route involves 10101 m of ascent and 9958 m of descent. It is classified as hard due to the distance and ascent. The walking time is about 217 hours on the DIN 33466 hiking time rule. The path passes the M43 Tisza bridge within 400 m and the Medieval church in Kővágószőlős within 1300 m.
